allow: PowerShell($content = Get-Content "style.css" -Raw; $opens = \($content.ToCharArray\(\) | Where-Object { $_ -eq '{' }\).Count; $closes = \($content.ToCharArray\(\) | Where-Object { $_ -eq '}' }\).Count; "open: $opens, close: $closes, diff: $\($opens - $closes\)")
Bash(python -c "import pypdf; r=pypdf.PdfReader\('Resume.pdf'\); print\('pages',len\(r.pages\)\); [print\(p.extract_text\(\)\) for p in r.pages]")
Bash(python -c "import pypdf; r=pypdf.PdfReader\('Resume.pdf'\); print\('pages',len\(r.pages\)\); [print\('---PAGE',i,'---\\n',p.extract_text\(\)\) for i,p in enumerate\(r.pages\)]")

Bash(python -c "import pypdf; r=pypdf.PdfReader\('Resume.pdf'\); open\('_resume_dump.txt','w',encoding='utf-8'\).write\('\\n'.join\('---PAGE %d---\\n%s'%\(i,p.extract_text\(\)\) for i,p in enumerate\(r.pages\)\)\)")
